pages.text: Allows wireless access via a $(l:items_blocks_machines/wireless_terminals)Wireless Terminal$(/l). Range and power usage is determined based on the number of $(item)Wireless Booster$() installed.$(br2)A network can have any number of wireless access points with any number of $(item)Wireless Booster$() in each one, allowing you to optimize power usage and range by altering your setup.
Requires a $(l:ae2_mechanics/channels)channel$(/l).$(br2)Also used to bind $(l:items_blocks_machines/wireless_terminals)wireless terminals$(/l)
Used to increase the range of the wireless access point.
